claim: 122 observational reference events were evaluated under the frozen catalogue-scale design.
required_qualification: Catalogue-scale observational cohort only.
allowed_wording: F3A evaluated 122 observational reference events under the frozen design.

claim: The primary analysis retained all 9516 planned variants, including 3094 inadmissible inputs.
required_qualification: Inadmissibility is not non-selection.
allowed_wording: All 9,516 planned variants remain represented, including 3,094 inadmissible inputs.
prohibited_wording: The 3,094 inadmissible inputs were negative classifications.

claim: 65/122 events reproduced their frozen observational reference state at W00/P00/seed0.
required_qualification: Also disclose 51 mismatches and 6 inadmissible baselines.
allowed_wording: 65 of 122 events were baseline-concordant; the remaining baseline states are reported separately.
prohibited_wording: Most published QPPs reproduced at baseline.

claim: 51/61 PUBLISHED_QPP_REFERENCE events were REFERENCE_BASELINE_MISMATCH.
required_qualification: Mismatch is against the frozen reference state, not physical falsity.
allowed_wording: 51 of 61 published-QPP references did not reproduce their frozen observational state at F3A baseline.

claim: Among PUBLISHED_NOT_SELECTED_REFERENCE events: 57 were baseline concordant, 0 mismatched and 4 inadmissible.
required_qualification: Not-selected references are not physical negatives.
allowed_wording: The not-selected role had 57 concordant, 0 mismatch and 4 inadmissible baselines.

claim: Catalogue-scale QPP-reference transitions include both selection retention and selection loss.
required_qualification: Restricted to baseline-concordant transition-eligible QPP references.
allowed_wording: Catalogue-scale QPP-reference transitions include retained selections and losses.
prohibited_wording: Published QPPs have a measured false-negative rate.

claim: No SELECTION_GAINED transitions occurred within the baseline-concordant, transition-eligible not-selected scope.
required_qualification: Repeated perturbations of observational references; not ground-truth negatives.
allowed_wording: No baseline-relative gains occurred in the defined not-selected transition scope.
prohibited_wording: The observational false-positive rate is zero.

claim: F3A007 does not establish an observational false-positive rate.
required_qualification: No independent observational ground truth exists.
allowed_wording: Zero gains in the frozen scope are not an observational FPR estimate.

claim: 116/116 W00/P00 eligible events were classification-stable across seeds 0–9.
required_qualification: Restricted to the frozen W00/P00 seed grid.
allowed_wording: All 116 eligible W00/P00 events retained binary classification across seeds 0–9.

claim: Classification stability does not imply a unique numerical optimum.
required_qualification: Convergence is not auditable and parameter payloads differ.
allowed_wording: Stable classification is distinct from numerical uniqueness.
prohibited_wording: Classification stability proves a unique optimum.

claim: Numerical multiplicity remains present despite binary classification stability.
required_qualification: Different parameter payloads are numerical diagnostics, not proved distinct physical optima.
allowed_wording: Ten parameter payloads per model coexist with stable binary classification.

claim: Period robustness is conditional on retained selection and comprises 295 comparable rows.
required_qualification: Selected→selected only; lost/inadmissible cases excluded by design.
allowed_wording: The period plane contains 295 selected→selected comparable rows.
prohibited_wording: Period was robust for all planned variants.

claim: The qualitative procedural-sensitivity pattern observed in F2 is also present at catalogue scale, subject to different denominators and baseline reproduction.
required_qualification: Do not pool F2/F3A and disclose the 51/61 QPP baseline mismatch limitation.
allowed_wording: Procedural sensitivity appears both in the pilot and at catalogue scale.

claim: F2 and F3A denominators must not be pooled.
required_qualification: Documentary comparison only.
allowed_wording: F2 and F3A are compared qualitatively without pooled rates.

claim: AFINO has not been observationally validated.
required_qualification: Robustness characterization is not performance validation.
allowed_wording: Phase 3A does not establish observational validation of AFINO.

claim: Sensitivity, specificity and observational FPR are not established.
required_qualification: No independent observational ground truth.
allowed_wording: No sensitivity, specificity or observational FPR claim is established.

claim: Physical QPP truth is not established.
required_qualification: Observational roles are reference states only.
allowed_wording: F3A does not establish physical QPP truth.

claim: A validated correction / selection function requires F3B.
required_qualification: Freeze development/held-out architecture before execution.
allowed_wording: Correction/selection-function validation is deferred to F3B.

claim: Manuscript 1 retains a supported robustness component, while its validation/correction component remains pending F3B.
required_qualification: Keep robustness and validation components distinct.
allowed_wording: Manuscript 1 can retain the robustness component while validation remains pending.

claim: F3A proves F2.
required_qualification: Different denominators and a new baseline limitation prevent that synthesis.
allowed_wording: F3A extends the procedural stress test and shows a related qualitative pattern.

claim: The observational false-positive rate is zero.
required_qualification: SELECTION_GAINED=0 is not a ground-truth performance metric.
allowed_wording: No gains were observed in the defined observational-reference scope.

claim: The 51 QPP-reference baseline mismatches are false QPP detections.
required_qualification: Mismatch is against frozen reference state; cause and physical truth unresolved.
allowed_wording: The 51 mismatches are a baseline-reproduction limitation.

claim: Catalogue scale validates AFINO.
required_qualification: Scale-up without ground truth is not validation.
allowed_wording: Catalogue scale characterizes observational robustness and limitations.
